verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to its platform. Through it, users can build audiences, manage and create syncs, design and analyze journeys, generate ad creatives and analyze campaign performance in plain language, with example prompts given. The probe confirms the dedicated docs page, and the API guide notes keys can be scoped for AI tools. Missing for 10: documented connection specifics in the evidence (transport, auth flow, supported clients), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection.
